Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for working through the redlines. Attached is our consolidated redline (Orion_Redlines_MSA_v3.pdf). Legal has signed off internally; we want to move to signature this week. Quick questions so we can finalize our internal checklist: 

- Proposed signer from Orion for the MSA: Arun Patel, SVP Finance (has authority up to $5M).
- Proposed signer for Order Form (purchase side): Samira Khan, Head of Partnerships (delegated authority via PO) — we can send the delegation letter if you need it.
- Do you require a corporate resolution or signed authority letter for either signer?
- Are there witness or notary requirements on your side? Orion’s procurement team prefers DocuSign routing with the external signers first, then counterparty.

Also: can you confirm who at Redwood will be the final countersigner and whether Redwood needs a separate signature block for the Order Form (we have a slightly different title than in the template).

If useful, we can host a 15-min sync today to confirm.

Thanks —
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Orion HealthTech

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution owners & logistics for MSA + Order Form

Samira — thanks for the redline and the quick turnaround. Plan below to get this across the line this week: 

1) Signer confirmation: Arun and Samira both OK from our side. Please upload the delegation letter for Samira (we'll need that to comply with our internal e-sign audit). If you can also send a corporate certificate for Orion it speeds accounting, but delegation letter alone is fine.

2) DocuSign routing: Redwood prefers the customer sign first, then Redwood legal/corp. Proposed routing order: 
   - Signer 1: Samira Khan (Order Form) 
   - Signer 2: Arun Patel (MSA) 
   - Signer 3: Redwood (Marissa Cole, Counsel) 

   If Orion needs Redwood to sign last, that matches our standard. We can set Marissa as the final countersigner.

3) Signature blocks: Please confirm the exact name/title to appear on each signature block. For Orion we'll mirror the signer's legal name and the job title you provide — if the title on the Order Form differs from what's on the corporate docs, add a note in the delegation letter.

4) Witness/notary: Redwood does not require notary or witness for this agreement. If Orion does, let us know and we'll escalate.

5) Clean copies: Once the envelope is complete we will produce a signed clean PDF (Redwood_Final_Clean_YYYYMMDD.pdf) and the DocuSign envelope link. We will also attach a PDF certificate of completion.

Next steps: Samira — if you can send the delegation letter and confirm exact signature titles by EOD today I will create the envelope and loop Marissa to countersign. If helpful we can do a 10-min check-in at 3pm PT.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Order of signing is fine; Redwood will be the final countersignatory. Marissa Cole (General Counsel) will sign for Redwood.
- We do need the delegation letter for Samira. Please ask Orion legal to attach it in the envelope or email it directly to me (marissa.cole@redwood.com). The delegation should reference the Order Form date and specify delegated signature authority.
- Envelope template: please use our "Standard MSA + Order Form (Customer first)" template. I will review the envelope before we send the final request.
- Mobile signature: acceptable. DocuSign's default mobile/email identity checks are sufficient; if Orion requires additional KBA let us know.

I reviewed Orion_Redlines_MSA_v3.pdf and accepted the non-material redlines. I have attached a single-page approval stub (redline_approved.pdf) to confirm legal sign-off. Once I get the delegation letter and confirmation of signatory titles I will countersign the envelope.
